message: The threat of Qin expanding from Luoyang is undeniable and endangers our shared security. I agree to a non-aggression pact and will coordinate my defenses along our common border to prevent Qin from exploiting any weakness. We must stand firm now to preserve our independence against their growing power.
reasoning: Han acts as a vital buffer state against Qin; letting them fall would expose Wei's western flank directly to Qin's strongest armies. Securing this alliance stabilizes the region and prevents a two-front war, allowing Wei to focus on expansion elsewhere once Qin is contained.
